exposure: Multiple attempts for successful spinal anesthesia
Spinal anesthesia with 26G Quincke spinal needle
outcome: Incidence of post dural puncture headache (PDPH)
cohort: 335 patients undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia from January 2019 to September 2019 at a medical college in rural India
finding: The incidence of PDPH was 11.4%, with the majority of patients (62.5%) experiencing mild pain, and all cases reported within 72 hours.
